title: Weil lift formulas, permitted Hom pairs and pullback-square components
statement: Use Weil fixed pairs for endofunctors as in [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. For categories $C,B$, endofunctors $P,Q$, a functor $F:C\to B$ and a comparison $\alpha:QF\simeq FP$, define the covariant lift specification to be the conjunction that forgetting the fixed-pair transport gives $F$, that its object structure is $\alpha_K$ followed by $F(\theta_K)$, and that its arrow action is $F(u)$ with the equation $\alpha_K F(\theta_K)F(u)=Q(F(u))\alpha_LF(\theta_L)$. For a predicate $J$ on $C^{op}\times C$, define its Weil-pair predicate by $J(K,L)=J(K_{\mathrm{carrier}},L_{\mathrm{carrier}})$ and its forgetful functor by forgetting both structures. For the rational and common-stage derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], define the component at a commuting scheme square $g_X f=f g_Y$ to be the inverse pullback compositor, followed by transport across this equality, followed by the other pullback compositor of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. This definition makes no assertion that a comparison is invertible beyond its specified isomorphism input.
